# `pygeovision status`

A short status page - PyGeoVision, `pygeofetch`, `torch` and `rasterio` versions, provider count and registered models.

## When to use it

Use it for a quick look; use [`doctor`](doctor.md) when something is wrong.

## What you get

Version lines with ticks; `--json` prints the same as JSON.

## Commands

### `pygeovision status`

```text
Usage: pygeovision status [OPTIONS]

  Show PyGeoVision, pygeofetch, and native AI stack status.

Options:
  --json  Output as JSON.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```
